title: Intel Arizona Manufacturing Technician Apprenticeship Launch
summary: Arizona records Intel's launch of a one-year registered apprenticeship for manufacturing facility technicians.
key_findings: Selected apprentices become full-time Intel employees on day one.
Successful completion is intended to produce a certificate and college credit.
The release plans dozens of apprentices over five years without reporting results.
why_it_matters: It provides an employer-linked training design against which completions and retention can be checked.
ftfn_relevance: Advances one named Phase 55Y reader journey.
Separates the current evidence stage from downstream operation or outcome claims.
Creates a specific next-record watch point.
evidence_limits: The source record used for this dossier is an official state announcement, not an outcome report.
No completion, credential, retention, or placement result is disclosed.
